interpretation.conclusion: These historical estimates inform country-specific research. They do not prove actual CPC, affordable delivery at the ceiling, profitability, or that a market cannot serve at the ceiling. Narrow product-aligned exact candidates remain unqualified until their own auction, route, measurement and cost evidence is obtained.

limitations: Idea counts describe the research response, not a count of relevant, affordable or approved keywords.
Core-phrase results do not qualify the different exact phrases in the Search campaign drafts.
Missing bid or volume estimates are unknown, not zero cost or proof of no demand.
In Account labels do not establish exact campaign ownership or keyword match type.
Country research is English only; Canada French and other native-language markets remain separate work.
The UI Save failure on the current PMax editor remains unresolved; no research action bypassed that gate.
All four country rows were seen in this session; the time range is a capture bound, not an invented exact timestamp for each row.
